verdict.rationale: TruffleHog explicitly documents a custom regex detector for defining organization-specific token/secret formats, with optional webhook-based verification, plus CLI flags (--include-detectors, --verify-detectors) to control which custom or built-in detectors run. This directly matches the security-engineer's need to define internal secret format rules. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community validation of the custom-detector feature specifically (community evidence present is unrelated to this axis).
